versionPairs.description: A real esbuild 0.27.2 iife bundle (unminified) whose vendor half dominates: 24 tiny CJS deps via __commonJS (all extracted to vendor/, one wrapper-scope `var require_*` each) against a small ESM app half plus one lazy __esm module (~37% of the app code: the fresh grouping, finding #87). The ORIGINAL bundle clears the frozen ≥50 wrapper-binding threshold (64 bindings); the POST-EXTRACTION runtime the split is handed sits under it (40) — the mid-size-app shape that failed the split loud until the threshold moved to the run's input (2026-10-02). v1.1.0 perturbs the last dep (adds tripled) and the lazy report line.
